p: LORD of hosts: David complains that he cannot have access to the Church of God to make profession of his faith, and to profit in religion.
courts of the LORD: For only the priests could enter the sanctuary and the rest of the people into the courts.
altars: So that the poor birds have more freedom than I.
strength is in thee: Who trusts nothing in himself but in you only, and learns from you to rule his life.
Baca make it a well: So that the poor birds have more freedom than I.
strength to strength: They are never weary but increase in strength and courage till they come to God's house.
anointed: That is, for Christ's sake, whose figure I represent.
a day in thy courts is: He would rather live one day in God's Church than a thousand in the world.
good thing will he withhold from: But will from time to time increase his blessings toward his more and more.
